hero.prompt: A painterly editorial illustration of an earthy ascent at dusk — the arid La Guajira coast of Colombia rising toward distant mountain peaks, a disciplined climb from sea-level desert to high ridgeline. Slate-grey, ochre and deep-earth tones ground the lower half of the scene; a cool, structured Saturn-toned light — muted silver-bronze, ringed-planet austerity — fills the upper sky. Palette deep indigo fading to near-black (#16112c to #0b0a1b) with ochre and bronze accents throughout. Resolute, patient, structured atmosphere. Full-bleed wide 16:9 composition that fills the entire frame. ONE single continuous landscape scene, no split screen, no diptych, no two panels, no diagram, no chart wheel, no central framed card, no text or letters or numerals, no human faces
